findings.problem: The old loop did not retry every rejection. It threw the final send error when the budget was exhausted, and a rejected sleep prevented another send. The supported distinction is that it did not classify send failures.

evidence.quote:
if (attempt === retries) throw error;
      await sleep(10);

findings.problem: Saying the old loop retried until its budget ran out omits material early termination paths: a successful send returned immediately, and a sleep rejection propagated even with budget remaining.

evidence.quote:
if (attempt === retries) throw error;
      await sleep(10);
sleep returns a promise; rejection propagates.

edits.value: The old loop did not classify send failures

The old loop retried rejected sends while retry budget remained and the requested sleep resolved. It requested a ten-millisecond delay between attempts. A successful send ended the loop; a rejected sleep propagated without another send.
